bastoni-08.exo: Speed, messages, journeys, news that arrives all at once. It points to rapid developments, travel, decisive communications and solutions found in a flash.
bastoni-08.psy: The mind lit up by enthusiasm: thoughts racing and seeking immediate expression. It asks you to give the speed a direction so that it does not become agitation.
bastoni-08.ini: Fire in Hod, the Splendour of the intellect, with Mercury in Sagittarius in the first decan: will transformed into thought and signal. Swiftness is fire turned into luminous vibration, energy that travels more than it burns.
bastoni-08.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals haste, scatter, hurried words, misunderstood messages or impulsive departures.
bastoni-08.up: Things are moving fast: respond promptly and use the favourable wave while it lasts.
bastoni-08.rev: Delays, missed or contradictory messages; or a hurry that breeds errors and misunderstandings.
bastoni-08.love: Messages, declarations, love at first sight; a relationship that suddenly speeds up.
bastoni-08.work: Awaited news, fast contracts, projects gaining speed; clear communication helps.
bastoni-08.spirit: Light as the messenger of the Will: sudden intuitions to be welcomed and checked.
bastoni-08.crowley: The Thoth deck shows beams of electric light crossing beneath a rainbow and drawing a geometric solid: energy as a light wave, the pure speed of thought.

bastoni-09.exo: Strength, health, physical and moral energy. It points to the ability to withstand and recover thanks to solid inner resources, and to a well-defended position.
bastoni-09.psy: Inner stability that comes from accepting your own rhythms; trust in a vitality that regenerates after every effort.
bastoni-09.ini: Fire in Yesod, the Foundation, with the Moon in Sagittarius in the second decan: the arrow of aspiration finds a stable base in the lunar rhythm. Strength is energy that renews itself cyclically, sustained by the alternation of Sun and Moon.
bastoni-09.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals obstinacy, mistrust, defensive rigidity, suspicion toward anyone who approaches.
bastoni-09.up: You have the resources to carry on: your staying power is greater than you think. Change does not weaken you, it recharges you.
bastoni-09.rev: Tiredness, excessive defences, mistrust; a need for rest and regeneration before the next effort.
bastoni-09.love: A solid relationship that has come through trials; take care not to experience the other person as a threat.
bastoni-09.work: Perseverance, the ability to bear pressure, recovery after a difficult period.
bastoni-09.spirit: Strength as harmony between the lunar and solar cycles of inner energy.
bastoni-09.crowley: Nine arrows, eight crossed and a larger one in the centre, carry the Sun and the Moon at their ends: strength is born from their harmonious alternation.

bastoni-10.exo: Burdens, excessive responsibilities, pressure. It points to a period of fatigue, of accumulated obligations and of energy spent without real satisfaction.
bastoni-10.psy: The will stiffened into obstinacy: you keep pushing out of habit or pride, even when the purpose has been lost.
bastoni-10.ini: Fire in Malkuth, with Saturn in Sagittarius in the third decan: force is imprisoned by the density of matter and the Saturnine limit. Oppression is the will cut off from its spiritual source, fire that burns only itself.
bastoni-10.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals tyranny, cruelty, physical and moral exhaustion, blind obstinacy.
bastoni-10.up: You are carrying more than is healthy: reduce, delegate, let go of what is not yours.
bastoni-10.rev: The weight begins to lighten, or the overload is denied until the breaking point.
bastoni-10.love: A relationship lived as an obligation or a burden; a need to question the roles.
bastoni-10.work: Too much work, stress, disproportionate responsibilities; priorities need redefining.
bastoni-10.spirit: Freeing yourself from self-imposed constraints and rediscovering the reason for your acting.
bastoni-10.crowley: Eight wands are barred by two great dorjes that dominate them, amid flames now dark: the force of fire imprisoned, become pure resistance.

bastoni-cavaliere.exo: An ardent, quick, generous and impulsive person, or a phase of sudden action. It points to departures, courageous undertakings, surges that are hard to hold back.
bastoni-cavaliere.psy: The side of the personality that acts before reflecting: enthusiasm, courage, a need for movement. It can be a gift or an excess.
bastoni-cavaliere.ini: Fire of Fire, the Yod of Yod, referred to Chokmah: the fastest and most violent force of the element, like lightning. It rules from 21° Scorpio to 20° Sagittarius, joining Martial ardour to Jupiterian aspiration.
bastoni-cavaliere.sha: Ill-dignified, he is cruel, intolerant, brutal and unable to complete what he begins.
bastoni-cavaliere.up: Act now with energy: the moment rewards courage and immediate initiative.
bastoni-cavaliere.rev: An impulse burnt out or held back; undertakings abandoned halfway, aggression or haste.
bastoni-cavaliere.love: Overwhelming passion, an impetuous lover; the fire can go out quickly.
bastoni-cavaliere.work: Rapid initiatives, relocations, bold projects to be sustained over time.
bastoni-cavaliere.spirit: The fire of the Will bursting in; learning to keep the flame alive beyond the first surge.
bastoni-cavaliere.crowley: Crowley shows a warrior in armour on a galloping black steed, carrying a flaming torch: the primordial force of fire in its race.

bastoni-regina.exo: A charismatic, warm, self-assured woman or person, or the ability to lead with affectionate authority. It points to charm, generosity and serene strength.
bastoni-regina.psy: Energy received and sustained: self-confidence, warmth, the ability to support others without losing yourself. It can stiffen into pride.
bastoni-regina.ini: Water of Fire, the He of Yod, referred to Binah: fire made fluid and constant. She rules from 21° Pisces to 20° Aries, joining the Neptunian sensitivity of Pisces to the impetus of Aries.
bastoni-regina.sha: Ill-dignified, she becomes vindictive, tyrannical, jealous, quick to nurse a grudge.
bastoni-regina.up: Show your strength with calm and warmth: you can influence the situation with your presence.
bastoni-regina.rev: Wounded self-esteem, possessiveness, pride; or energy held back for fear of shining.
bastoni-regina.love: A warm and passionate partner; a relationship founded on trust and passion.
bastoni-regina.work: Charismatic leadership, confident management, creative projects.
bastoni-regina.spirit: The guarded flame: the inner fire fed with constancy.
bastoni-regina.crowley: The Queen of the Thoth deck, crowned with the winged disk, sits in contemplation amid flames, with a leopard at her side and a thyrsus topped by a pine cone: the force of fire controlled and serene.

bastoni-principe.exo: A young or energetic, generous and proud person, or an undertaking led with passion and speed. It points to decisive actions, courageous initiatives, a wish to leave a mark.
bastoni-principe.psy: The creative ego that wants to assert itself: enthusiasm, the ability to carry others along, but also a need for recognition and a tendency to take offence over nothing.
bastoni-principe.ini: Air of Fire, the Vau of Yod, referred to Tiphareth: fire becoming active intelligence and vision. He rules from 21° Cancer to 20° Leo, transforming the protective sensitivity of Cancer into the solar pride of Leo.
bastoni-principe.sha: Ill-dignified, he is arrogant, violent, intolerant, vain and ready to impose himself by force.
bastoni-principe.up: Carry your ideas forward with passion and speed: your energy is contagious and opens the way.
bastoni-principe.rev: Wounded pride, outbursts of anger, projects blocked by vanity or impatience.
bastoni-principe.love: A generous and romantic lover, at times vain; an intense and eventful relationship.
bastoni-principe.work: Dynamic initiatives, creative leadership, promoting yourself and your projects.
bastoni-principe.spirit: Ennobling strength with a purpose that goes beyond the ego.
bastoni-principe.crowley: The Prince of the Thoth deck drives a chariot drawn by a lion amid flames, holding the wand of the phoenix: fire becoming conscious will and being reborn from itself.

bastoni-principessa.astro: Celestial quadrant of Cancer, Leo, Virgo; throne of the Ace
bastoni-principessa.exo: A brilliant, bold young person, or a beginning full of enthusiasm. It points to stimulating news, new ideas, courageous initiatives and an energy that is hard to contain.
bastoni-principessa.psy: The fresh and fearless part of yourself that experiments, dares and lets itself be carried by enthusiasm; fire lived in the body without fear.
bastoni-principessa.ini: Earth of Fire, the final He of Yod, referred to Malkuth: fire incarnating and offering itself. Throne of the Ace of Wands, she rules the celestial quadrant of Cancer, Leo and Virgo, bringing the spark into matter.
bastoni-principessa.sha: Ill-dignified, she is superficial, cruel, unstable, prone to whims and sudden anger.
bastoni-principessa.up: Dare: a spark of inspiration asks to become a concrete gesture, right now.
bastoni-principessa.rev: Enthusiasm spent or scattered in a thousand directions; whims, instability, broken promises.
bastoni-principessa.love: Seduction, spontaneous passion, flirting; plenty of warmth, less constancy.
bastoni-principessa.work: New ideas, creative projects, a spirit of initiative; a method that gives continuity helps.
bastoni-principessa.spirit: The incarnated flame: the sacred lived in vital impulse and courage.
bastoni-principessa.crowley: The Princess of the Thoth deck stands naked amid flames, with a wand topped by the sun, a tiger at her side and an altar decorated with ram's heads: fire made body, bold and free.
